becomeMotherPromptTitle: Host a new game on this device?
becomeMotherPromptBody: No mother device is reachable on the network, so this device will become the mother and host a NEW game. Other devices can then join it. To resume a game in progress whose mother went down, use the red "Take over the game" banner instead.
pinResetBanner: The device PIN was reset with a recovery code. Set a new PIN so the security gates work again.
